evidence.post_text:
One workaround that has come up in similar threads here: the separate $2,500 OpenAI credit benefit was removed from the Founders Hub benefits section, but the Azure credits still cover Azure OpenAI Service, so you can run the same OpenAI models against your Azure balance while the direct credit is stuck. If the support ticket stays unanswered that is usually the fastest working path.

For checking what each program currently offers before you chase support, there is a public registry at [sourcey.com](https://sourcey.com/c/microsoft) that tracks the Microsoft for Startups terms and the separate OpenAI startup credits entry, each with the date it was last read from the source. It is a quick way to confirm whether a benefit still exists.
